user.title: Search for PDU-9 hosts
user.description: The following devices were found on the local network. Pick the one to add.

manual.title: Add a PDU-9 manually
manual.description: Enter the IP address of the PDU-9 host. The control port defaults to 1002.

discovery_confirm.title: PDU-9 host discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Found {name} ({host}) on the local network. Add it?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP address, that the device is powered on, and that no other software is holding the connection.

abort.already_configured: This device has already been added.
abort.not_pdu9: That device is not a PDU-9 host.

data_description.scan_interval_seconds: The device handles about 40 requests per second. Default is 3 seconds.

power_cycle.name: Power cycle
power_cycle.description: Cut power to a channel for a number of seconds, then switch it back on. Once started, power is always restored.

off_seconds.name: Off duration
off_seconds.description: Seconds to stay powered off. Defaults to 5.

set_mode_delays.name: Set scene delays
set_mode_delays.description: Set the staggered switch-on delays for all 9 channels in a scene (protocol 1.10).

delays.name: Delays
delays.description: Nine values for CH1-CH9 in seconds. Use -1 to leave a channel out of this scene.

get_mode_delays.name: Get scene delays
get_mode_delays.description: Read the staggered switch-on delays for all 9 channels in a scene (protocol 1.11). A value of -1 means the channel is not part of the scene.

run_sequence.name: Run sequence
run_sequence.description: Switch all channels one by one in a fixed order: on = CH1 to CH9, off = CH9 to CH1. The device handles one command at a time, so commands must be sent one by one with a gap for the order to be deterministic.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: on switches channels on one by one, off switches them off.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Seconds to wait between channels. Defaults to 1.
